How this result was produced. Every case is scored by the AEGIS AI ensemble — 3 decision engines voting by majority, cross-checked against 4 reference engines. Engine identity, architecture, and internal weighting are protected AEGIS research IP and are never disclosed; only the ensemble’s governance-zone result is shown here.
